Scope: playgrounds at three locations (Qassim Oasis, Hail and Tabuk Industrial City), with civil, architectural, electrical, mechanical and landscape works and general site works, including air domes at Qassim and Tabuk and a toilet building at each site.

Status at a glance

Progress is measured as physical % complete, weighted by budgeted man-hours (weekly report, Physical Progress sheet). At 15-Nov-2026 the project is 83.78% complete against 90.47% planned, behind by 6.69% (SPI 0.93). It gained 1.56% this week against 2.70% planned, so the gap widened from 5.55% to 6.69%.

The schedule now finishes the project 83 days after the contract date. The P6 update (data date 13-Nov-2026) and the weekly report both forecast handover on 09-Mar-2027 against the contract completion date of 16-Dec-2026, with −70.2 days of float; last week the forecast was 02-Mar-2027. 178 of the 283 open activities have negative float and 37 activities have failed to start. The air domes are furthest behind: Qassim 39.96% against 90.77% planned and Tabuk 35.13% against 86.38%, with no progress for the fifth week running.

Data notes

  • Progress figures are the weekly report's physical progress (effort), weighted by 33,340 budgeted man-hours. 10,000 of them (30%) sit on the time-based “Project Durations” activities (management line), which earn progress as time passes and stand at 88.79% (8,879 man-hours; in P6, 4,100 complete and 5,900 at 81%). Without them the project would be 81.63% complete against 91.17% planned, behind by 9.54% rather than 6.69%. The two air domes carry only 1,116 man-hours each (6.7% of all man-hours) although they are 23.4% of the contract value, so their stoppage hardly moves the physical %. By comparison, the invoiced value to date is 4,244,771 SAR (11.9% of the contract value) and the FIR value to date 4,353,088 SAR (12.2%). This week's files do not change this; the report still shows the contractor's physical % as given. The report's dashboard shows cost-based progress labelled as actual; this report uses physical progress only.
  • The report states “Current Contract Weeks: 0 of 0”, so the week number is counted from site handover (17-Feb-2026): 271 days, week 38.
  • The “Weekly Physical Progress” columns hold 81.92% planned and 73.10% earned, which match neither week's to-date figures. Progress this week is taken as the change in to-date progress since the 08-Nov-2026 report.
  • All major quantities are identical in the five reports from 18-Oct to 15-Nov-2026, although tartan, kerbstone, irrigation and fence work was reported; the sheet appears not to have been updated.
  • Man-hours by site: Tabuk toilet building still shows 0 of 1,708 man-hours earned with only 40 planned, and Tabuk closeout has no budget but 114 man-hours earned. Each of the three sites shows exactly 114 closeout man-hours earned (76.72 each last week).
  • The milestone sheet now gives complete construction as 20-Feb-2027 (13-Feb-2026 last week), but still gives complete mobilisation as 14-Apr-2026 against 18-Mar-2026 with 0 days change.
  • Procurement: the summary has 8 of 57 materials on site, unchanged for four weeks, while the P6 delivery activities are 80–95% complete. The procurement log has no delivered quantities or dates.
  • Invoices: the summary shows 0 submitted invoices while the log lists IPC-01 to IPC-03. Paid invoices (4,348,338 SAR) exceed the gross submitted value although none is PM-approved. The FIR summary total rose to 4,353,088, 108,318 above the gross invoiced value: the increase is a second copy of the FIR-0529 and FIR-0550 rows (48,318) and a 60,000 line with no FIR reference; FIR-0630 still appears twice. The dashboard's penalties of −469,477 combine advance payment recovery and deductions.
  • Manpower: the dashboard shows 46 manual workers while the Manpower sheet has 65 for November, and the Manpower sheet is unchanged from last week. The safety statistics now agree (11,700 man-hours worked and safe this week). The DB sheet still holds another project's data (HAL1-02-005).
  • The P6 update has a data date of 13-Nov-2026, against 15-Nov-2026 for the weekly report. No in-progress activity now has a finish date before the data date (131 last week). Three PDFs are still named MLTX-05-047 although they belong to MLTX-02-003.
  • The contractor forecast in the Physical-Chart Data sheet starts at 0 in February, 365 man-hours below the actual, so it stays slightly below actual until October.
